indus-ops.description: Self-hosted agency operations fleet for INDUS Web Agency. One login hub, local Ollama, and a bot per job. Mail, posts, deploys, and fixes wait for approval.

indus-bot-core.description: Shared TypeScript SDK for INDUS bots: a single local LLM lock, approval records, SSO, SQLite, and the service shell every bot runs.

indus-monitor-bot.description: Uptime, TLS certificate expiry, disk, memory, and allowlisted systemd restarts for the INDUS Ops VPS. Failed units wait for approval unless you opted in.

indus-seo-bot.description: On-page SEO audits, sitemap change detection, IndexNow pings, and blog drafts for INDUS sites. Drafts wait in the approval inbox.

indus-mailforge-bot.description: Reads local MailForge stats, cleans mailing lists, and drafts campaigns. A campaign is scheduled only after approval and only with a future send time.

indus-inquiries-bot.description: Collects IMAP mail and contact-form posts, classifies them, and drafts replies. SMTP sends only after you approve the draft.

indus-leads-bot.description: Collects public software-job listings from Remotive and We Work Remotely, scores them, and drafts proposals. Nothing is submitted to a marketplace.

indus-reports-bot.description: Writes a daily markdown digest of every INDUS bot: status, last summary, and how many approvals are waiting. Email goes out only when you enable it.

indus-marketing-bot.description: Drafts LinkedIn posts, a local product reel, and an organic pack for X, Facebook, and Reddit. Publishing waits for approval, and Reddit is never auto-posted.

indus-scheduler-bot.description: The only clock in INDUS Ops. Runs cron jobs, intervals, and one-offs, retries with backoff, and can pause every bot.

indus-commander-bot.description: Writes the INDUS morning plan from your goals and queues safe internal tasks. It cannot publish, send, deploy, restore, or apply a fix.

indus-security-bot.description: Audits SSH, firewall status, unexpected listeners, failed logins, and pending security upgrades. Only two fixes can be applied, and only after approval.

indus-backup-bot.description: Copies the paths you list, writes sha256 checksums, prunes old copies, and runs a restore drill. A live restore still waits for approval.

indus-devops-bot.description: Lists recent GitHub repositories for triage and redeploys one allowlisted app with git pull --ff-only and systemctl restart, only after approval.

indus-content-bot.description: Drafts long-form articles in English, Spanish, French, Urdu, Punjabi, Sindhi, and Haitian Creole. Each article waits for approval before it is published.

indus-translator-bot.description: Drafts localized pages with hreflang alternates for the INDUS agency languages. The HTML file is written to disk only after you approve it.

indus-crm-bot.description: Keeps a local pipeline of new, qualified, proposal, won, and lost clients, fed by Inquiries and Leads. Quote drafts are not sent.

indus-invoice-bot.description: Records quotes and invoices and builds a one-page PDF. There is no payment processor. You mark a document paid by hand.

indus-support-bot.description: Product chat widget for INDUS sites. Answers from the docs you configure, refuses invented prices, and escalates to Inquiries instead of sending email.

indus-competitor-bot.description: Watches public competitor pages, honors robots.txt, and summarizes what changed. It does not bypass disallows or invent prices it did not read.

indus-analytics-bot.description: First-party page analytics for INDUS sites. Stores a path, referrer, and a daily salted visitor hash. Raw IP addresses are not kept.
